decisions.statement: One process on the workstation is the only thing anywhere that renews a model account's token.
Everything else that has a credential reads the credential rather than making a credential.
A pass goes through the model-account pages in alphabetical order.
An account that is subscription-disabled is passed over.
A renewed token and a fresh usage reading are written back onto the account.
A rate-limit window that has gone inactive is started again with a one-token message.
The usage is read a second time once a rate-limit window has been started again.
Accounts are a minute apart within a pass.
Nothing here decides which account a call goes on.
A restart waits out the rest of the period in which a window was triggered on any account.
A stop ends the loop at the loop's next boundary.
Whether upkeep is still running is ruled on elsewhere from the stamps upkeep leaves on each page.

definition: every model account's token and usage kept current, pass after pass
